preconditions: No loaded tuning; browse Tunings or add SCL/ASCL to a Places folder.
contract: Default pitch system is 12TET. Core tunings are available in Tunings; user files appear under User tag. Hover/select shows description and number of notes per octave in Info View. Browser indexing latency/errors U. The same description is shown when hovering the name of a loaded tuning.

preconditions: Double-click tuning in browser, or select+Enter; alternatively drag external SCL/ASCL into Tuning section.
contract: Load tuning into Set. Browser operations open initially hidden Tuning section; view menu also opens it. Loaded tuning is saved with Set. Precise reference defaults, multiple drop ordering and missing-file behavior U. The browser view control menu opens the section; the triangle beside the loaded file name expands additional settings and Tuning displays the loaded system name.

preconditions: Tuning loaded; view/hover/play piano roll note.
contract: Ruler displays tuning notes rather than conventional MIDI pitches; hover reports pitch/frequency in Status Bar and piano-roll/keyboard audition produces specified pitch in a compatible setup. Exact pitch generation/error tolerance U.

preconditions: Retune Set disabled; change/remove loaded tuning.
contract: Existing piano-roll note positions/indices stay; labels/pitches follow new system and may sound different. No destructive-retune confirmation appears in this mode. Preserve note index does not imply preserved frequency.

preconditions: Enable Retune Set On Loading Tuning Systems and load/change tuning. The explicit entry is Options > Retune Set On Loading Tuning Systems.
contract: Confirmation precedes retuning; existing notes are moved toward closest available pitches. Overlapping original pitches can map to one new pitch, deleting or shortening a note. Exact matching, ties, survivor, cancellation and bypassed-track treatment U.

preconditions: Load tuning with scale-aware clips/devices present.
contract: Clip View/Control Bar Scale Mode choosers disappear and scale-aware devices' Use Current Scale is disabled. This applies also to loaded 12-TET tuning. Hidden scale data, previous enable-state restoration and device-specific fallback U.

preconditions: Expand Tuning section; change reference Octave/Note without changing Ref. Pitch/Freq.
contract: Controls choose reference identity and update displayed frequency to match it without audible pitch change. Exact rescaled number and transient/controller output U.

preconditions: Loaded tuning; change Ref. Pitch/Freq.
contract: Adjust reference frequency, raising/lowering Set note pitches accordingly. This is the reference edit producing audible change; no global UI frequency control without a loaded tuning is asserted. Exact frequency mapping, limits and held-note transition U.

preconditions: Change Lowest Note or Highest Note's octave/pitch-class coordinates.
contract: Editing one updates the other while preserving number of intervening notes. Domain limits, nonmonotonic-frequency meaning and endpoint clamping U except documented file-range rules below.

preconditions: Save loaded tuning using disk button; optionally select link arrow.
contract: Save current tuning as ASCL into browser Tunings. If linked page exists arrow can open related tuning site; absent link grays arrow. Save/overwrite/cancel, URI filtering and browser launch failures U. ASCL SOURCE/LINK metadata does not guarantee a clickable URI.

preconditions: Select tuning in section and press Delete.
contract: Remove it and return to default 12TET. Note-position versus retuned-note consequences depend on Retune Set option, not an unconditional restoration of original pitches. Exact confirmation on removal and undo grouping U.

preconditions: Loaded tuning; enable a MIDI track's Bypass Tuning. The track tuning controls appear in MIDI track I/O while a tuning is loaded; no converse unloaded-hide law is asserted.
contract: Track ignores tuning, its clips show 12TET notes, and instruments/plugins receive original MIDI without retuning. Tracks containing Drum Racks automatically bypass tuning. Automatic toggle lifecycle after rack removal/nesting and layout interaction U.

preconditions: Choose All Keys / Black Keys Only / White Keys Only / Closest in Pitch to Keyboard. Use the MIDI track In/Out layout chooser with a tuning loaded.
contract: Map tuning notes respectively to all keys, black keys centered at C#3, white keys centered at C3, or nearest keyboard pitches. Exact mapping tables, ties, out-of-range keys and incoming-channel behavior U.

preconditions: Choose Custom Controller Layout, open ellipsis and edit valid layout.
contract: Open Configure MIDI Layout; custom layout is saved/recalled with Set. Allowed map domains, duplicate/unmapped keys, apply/cancel/undo and output routing semantics U.

preconditions: Use tuning with external hardware, plugin or Max receiver.
contract: Receiver must support and enable MPE, with per-note bend range ±48 semitones for the documented path. Incompatible/range-mismatched setups can be out of tune; there is no required precise failure sound. Manual's general built-in-instrument support is qualified by FAQ's Drum Synth exception; individual device scope remains U.

preconditions: Import SCL intervals lacking a reference, ASCL, or paired KBM.
contract: SCL intervals do not supply absolute frequency; Live generates a 440-Hz reference near middle of MIDI range. ASCL can carry reference; KBM is unsupported. Exact generated note choice is U except documented ASCL range positioning below; unsupported KBM UI response U.

preconditions: ASCL extension text follows pitch list using ! @ABL directives.
contract: Extensions are SCL comments; arguments use spaces, double quotes enclose spaces, UTF-8 is required. Files containing extensions with non-UTF-8 bytes must be rejected by a compliant extension parser. Extra initial ! disables a directive. Error UI and transactional recovery U.

preconditions: ASCL REFERENCE_PITCH and NOTE_NAMES.
contract: Reference arguments: octave integer -2..8, zero-based degree less than pitch count, nonzero positive frequency in Hz. NOTE_NAMES supplies one name per degree beginning at implied zero. Nonfinite, duplicate/missing/mismatched directives and out-of-domain handling U.

preconditions: Optional ASCL NOTE_RANGE_BY_FREQUENCY or NOTE_RANGE_BY_INDEX.
contract: More than one range directive is an error. Frequency bounds are 4..21000 Hz, max optional; index octave bounds -99..99, upper endpoint optional. Index form requires an earlier REFERENCE_PITCH. Range start is specified index or first note at/above minimum frequency; max is limited by 127 further steps, 21kHz and optional bound. Exact ties/cap priority and malformed reversal U.

preconditions: No ASCL range directive.
contract: General description centers available notes around A3 440Hz with 64 below and 63 above; twelve-note systems instead put pitch nearest A3 440Hz at index 69. Exact non-12-note center/tie and interaction with nonstandard explicit reference remain U.

preconditions: ASCL SOURCE/LINK metadata and nonmonotonic tuning with index range.
contract: SOURCE text describes origin; LINK describes URL and software may restrict direct access. Index bounds mean first/last tuning positions even when not lowest/highest frequency. UI safety policy, sorting/normalization and actual URI launch behavior U.
